features.title: Operation-aware next-step hint
features.gap: Rift Investigation and Shadow Crypt Lead exposed counts but no bounded next-action semantics.
features.adaptation: A non-mutating hint identifies the next Mall landmark or missing narrative evidence and explicitly reports completion.
features.acceptance: Hint changes deterministically as authoritative visit/evidence state changes and never mutates guide state.

features.title: Next-incomplete operation tracking
features.gap: Players/callers had to manually find the next unfinished operation after completing one.
features.adaptation: Cyclic next-incomplete selection skips completed operations, wraps deterministically, and stops without mutation when all are complete.
features.acceptance: Completed operations are skipped; all-complete state is idempotent.

features.title: Bounded multi-stop field route
features.gap: Only one temporary landmark pin existed for a three-site field loop.
features.adaptation: A fixed three-stop route preserves insertion order, rejects invalid/duplicate/visited/full additions, supports individual/batch removal, and prunes visited stops.
features.acceptance: No allocation or unbounded growth; legacy single pin remains higher priority; discovery removes a matching route stop once.

features.title: Unread field-journal notices
features.gap: Unlocked journal entries had no read/unread distinction.
features.adaptation: New entries begin unread and explicit read-one/read-all acknowledgement is idempotent; repeated evidence cannot resurrect a notice.
features.acceptance: Unread counts are exact and locked/invalid/already-read entries fail closed.

features.title: Consolidated field briefing
features.gap: Callers had to query progress, target, hint, route and journal state separately.
features.adaptation: A read-only briefing snapshot exposes the tracked operation, progress, hint, target, route count, journal counts and completed-operation count.
features.acceptance: Snapshot equals authoritative values and does not mutate tracking or route state.

features.title: Route-pin category visibility filter
features.gap: A multi-stop route would otherwise expose all pin categories at once with no clutter control.
features.adaptation: Original Objective/Resource/Note route categories can be filtered for visibility without deleting hidden stops; All restores them.
features.acceptance: Filtering changes only target visibility, invalid filters fail closed, and hidden route state remains intact.
